# TWb Viewer for DSH · Tableau Workbook Inspector
> **A delivery tool for Tableau consultants.** Inspect a workbook (`.twb`) inside DeepSeek Harness —
**no Tableau Desktop, no license, no data**: a 1:1 SVG dashboard layout you can hand to a client as
a whiteboard file, a table-level data model showing how the tables are joined, a field-level lineag

e graph, and the custom SQL behind each datasource.
> Everything is parsed **in your browser**; a De
epSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that reads metadata only and **never touches your data**.
中文 · English
## What problem it solves
Workbooks are the hardest thing to explain about a Tableau deployment. You have a `.twb` file — from
a client, a colleague, or your own archive — and you need to answer questions like:
- **What is actually in this dashboard?** Which worksheets sit where, how big are they, what is a co

ntainer vs. a worksheet vs. a text zone.
- **How do these calculated fields connect?** Which field f

eeds which, what breaks if I change a formula, where a field's lineage starts and ends.
- **How are
the tables joined?** A table-level data model: which table joins which, the ON condition, the join t

ype, and the cardinality when Tableau records it.
- **What SQL is behind this datasource?** Every cu
stom SQL (`<relation type='text'>`) pulled out and listed, so you can confirm the query logic line b

y line instead of opening Tableau.
- **What is this workbook wired to?** Server, database, file path

, field roles and data types — without opening Tableau.
- **How do I document it for a client?** A l
ayout you can export to Excalidraw/SVG and annotate, plus a lineage diagram you can walk through in
can export to Excalidraw/SVG and annotate, plus a lineage diagram you can walk through in a meeting.
Tableau Desktop shows you this by opening the workbook; DSH's plugin shows it in the browser, instan
tly, with no license and no data.
## Features
- ✅ **English & Chinese UI**: the panel follows the DSH interface language (switch it in Settings →

General → Language); dates, numbers and workbook data stay untouched.
- ✅ **One click from the left
sidebar**: the plugin registers its own panel row in the DSH sidebar, so it opens as a full page nex

t to your conversation — no digging through Settings.
- ✅ **Open and it is already there**: the plug
in auto-loads a built-in sample workbook, so you see the whole UI in one second — then drop in your

own `.twb` to replace it.
- ✅ **1:1 dashboard layout**: every dashboard zone is drawn as SVG at true
scale (worksheets, containers, text), with zoom / pan and one-click export to **SVG / PNG / Excalid

raw** for annotated review decks.
- ✅ **Table-level data model**: every datasource's relation tree i
s parsed into tables + joins — join type (inner/left/right/full), the ON expression, and cardinality
when the file records it — drawn as an arc diagram (balanced curves, children centred on their pare

nt) with a detail pane.
- ✅ **Parameters, read properly**: Tableau parameters get their own tab, wit
h the current value formatted by the workbook's own number format (`p0.00%` → `6.40%`, `C2052` → `¥5
0,000`) instead of the raw float64 stored in the file (`0.064000000000000001`); the raw value stays

visible for verification.
- ✅ **Custom SQL inventory**: each `<relation type='text'>` is extracted,
listed per datasource and copyable, so agreeing on the query logic takes one screen instead of a Tab

leau session.
- ✅ **Zone-level detail**: zone subtypes (worksheet / flow container / basic container
/ card such as filters and titles / text / empty) are colour-coded with a legend, and hovering a zo

ne shows its size, padding, margin and fill.
- ✅ **Field lineage graph**: layered dependency graph —
datasource → raw fields → calculated fields. Click any node for its **upstream inputs / downstream

dependents**, search, and filter by role (dimension / measure / calculation).

## Data safety: `.twb` only, `.twbx` is refused by design
| Format | What it contains | This plugin |
| `.twb` | **Metadata only** — XML with connection info, field definitions, calculation formulas, da

shboard zone layout. **No data rows.** | ✅ Supported |
| `.twbx` | A zip package that can embed **da
ta extracts** (`.hyper` / `.tde`), images, and more | ❌ **Refused on purpose** |
Refusing `.twbx` is a deliberate security decision: a packaged workbook can carry your full dataset,
and pulling that into an inspection flow widens the data-exposure surface for no benefit. The plugi
n only ever reads data-free `.twb` metadata. If you pick a `.twbx` you get an explicit message telli
ng you to **Save As → `.twb`** in Tableau.
## Screenshots
**Where it lives** — a panel row in the left sidebar; the viewer opens as a full page beside your co

**Data model** — tables, join types, ON conditions and cardinality (synthetic workbook; client files
never leave the machine)
**Parameters** — current values formatted the way the workbook formats them, raw values kept for ver

Install mechanisms used: `dsh.bundle.patch` (makes the package a loaded plugin row) and
`dsh.client`

with an exported `./client` bundle (injected into the browser module graph by
`client-modules`). Th

e UI registers itself into the `settings.section` slot, and the Node half
uses the `webServer` servi
ce for the sample route.
